text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day of the tryouts has come.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though I was hoping to have formally
scouted Manhattan Cafe by
now, an
opportune moment hasn't appeared.

text_block_list.name: New Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
<username>, are you
really looking to scout her?

text_block_list.name: New Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
Sure, she's a great runner,
but the way she keeps going on and on
about that
imaginary "friend" of hers is unsettling.
You're not put off by it?

text_block_list.name: New Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Y-you're kidding, right? I can understand
wanting to support her,
but...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Good morning.

text_block_list.name: The Two
text_block_list.text:
Waaaaah!
Gyaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thud, thud, thud!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...
I'm sorry... You were clearly in the
middle of something.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There are many capable runners set to
take to the track today. She'll need to
focus on outpacing them over anything
else. Will her friend end up leading the
pack, I wonder...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I was sure... that you couldn't see her.
But
it really feels like... you can...

text_block_list.name: Tryouts Staff A
text_block_list.text:
The tryouts are about to begin. Would the
runners participating
please gather—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...
Please come back here... this evening.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
The runners are at the starting gate.
And...
they're off! The race has
begun.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
(Run... run... run...
The smell of the turf...
The dirt is nice and firm...
I'm in great
form.)

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
(That person's...
That trainer's words seem
to have lent a spring to my step. My
breathing is stable...
I feel like I could run for much longer
than usual...)

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
(There are so many runners... in front of
me...)

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
(But I know that she's there...
I know that
my friend is up there...
waiting for me to
catch up to her.)

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
(No one else can see her... but she is so
dear to me...)

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
(I never did mind that people couldn't
believe what they couldn't
see... I only...
wished that they would respect her...)

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: (But now...)

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
(That trainer... wants to know more about
her...)

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
(Precisely because she can't be seen. Just
by saying that... my friend
has finally
gotten the respect she deserves.)

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Haaah!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
(We've endured so much ridicule... So
much cruelty... Never been
given the time
of day...)

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
(It's time to run past all that...
If I can get
even a little closer to you
today than I
could yesterday... then I...)

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I can run freely... after you... after my
dreams!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
What acceleration! She pierces through
the pack like a needle! She's
like a shadow
swallowing everything before her!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Woooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In contrast to the afternoon's tryouts,
the track this evening is still and
silent.
Manhattan Cafe stands before me,
pensively.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Please, can you listen to me for a moment?
I'd like to tell you... about
my friend...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Actually... I can see many, many things
that others can't. There are
other beings...
besides my friend...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
However... No one has ever believed that
when I told them.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"There's no way they exist." "Creepy."
"It's
just your imagination."
"You're delusional."
"It's all in your head."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Those awful words... They only served to
hurt my precious
companions... It made me
sad, too.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Because of that... I tended to keep to
myself as a child. I didn't want
them to be
hurt... any more.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I was always rather frail... The people
around me were never too
surprised that I
stayed mostly quiet.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
But one day...
I saw a girl who looked a lot
like me, even if only from
behind... She
was running.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
And even though I couldn't see her
face... I
could tell that she was
having fun. I started
to feel... envious...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I chased after...
Left that dark room that I
had shut myself in.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
The outside world was bright...
Overwhelmingly so. But my friend...
She
was still running... Having fun...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I began to wonder... what exactly I was so
afraid of. Even though no
one would
believe in her... she was able to run
without a care...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Since then... my friend has been running
ever forward... In front of
me...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Yes... But I've still...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...This whole time...
I've still not seen her
face.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I can't catch up... And she never looks
back... I've only ever seen her
from
behind... as she runs ever forward.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
So I want... to catch up.
I want to run... at
her side.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though she is telling me this in her usual
hushed voiced, I can sense
the
straightforward fervor that has welled up
inside her.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...
You still can't see her,
right? So... Um...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...
Do you think... I can catch up with her?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Okay!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thwack!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I share a smile with Manhattan Cafe, I
feel a strong clap on my
back.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: "I trust you."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's no voice—no spoken word. And
yet... I can feel the sentiment
coming from
someone.
